تستثنون (form X)
# تَسْتَثْنُونَ (tastaṯnūna) /tas.taθ.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
# تُسْتَثْنَوْنَ (tustaṯnawna) /tus.taθ.naw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَثْنَى (istaṯnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
